landing.heroTitle: The power of AI in agriculture
landing.heroSubtitle: SmartAgroAI — a modern platform uniting farmers, agronomists and AI technologies. Detect plant diseases, track weather and manage your farm.
landing.aboutText: An AI assistant built for farmers in Uzbekistan and Central Asia. Upload a photo — the system detects potential diseases and offers recommendations.
landing.diagnosisText: Upload a plant photo and within seconds get the likely disease, symptoms and recommendations.
landing.weatherText: Current weather and forecast for your region. Practical advice for crop care.
landing.collabText: Communicate directly with professional agronomists in real-time chat. Get expert answers to your questions.
landing.benefit1Text: The AI model analyzes a photo in seconds.
landing.benefit2Text: Full support for Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic), English and Russian.
landing.benefit3Text: Your data is protected; unauthorized access is blocked.
landing.benefit4Text: Use it on any device — phone, tablet or computer.
landing.telegramText: Link your account via the bot, receive notifications and check the weather.
landing.roleFarmerText: Manage your fields, track crops and use AI diagnosis.
landing.roleAgronomText: Work with farmers, give recommendations and handle requests.
landing.roleAdminText: Manage users, monitor system health and edit content.
